settings.enable_quick_mode.tooltip: In this mode, MouseMacros will only replay mouse and keyboard actions in the order they occurred, ignoring all pauses in between.
settings.allow_long_str.tooltip: When enabled, MouseMacros will try to display long tooltips in one line without wrapping.
settings.readjust_frame_mode.tooltip:
This option affects how MouseMacros handles 'historical window size (c)' and 'recommended window size (p)' after changing language settings.
MIXED is a mixed mode, taking the larger of c and p to calculate the minimum 3:2 window size.
STANDARDIZED is a standard mode, only using p to calculate the minimum 3:2 window size.
MEMORIZED is a memory mode, directly using 'historical window size (c)'.
settings.repeat_delay.tooltip: The waiting time required for the next repeat execution, supports up to three decimal places (milliseconds).

hotkey.warning.media_key: Warning: Media keys (volume, playback, etc.) may not record properly as they are often handled directly by hardware. Consider using regular key combinations instead.
hotkey.warning.fn_key:
NOTE: The Fn key itself CANNOT be recorded.

The Fn key is processed at the keyboard firmware level and does not generate system-visible key events. Any Fn+X functionality is actually the keyboard directly sending other keycodes, not an Fn key combination.
hotkey.help.recording_failure:
Why some keys cannot be recorded:
* Media keys (volume, playback) are handled by hardware
* Fn function keys vary across laptop models
* System-level hotkeys are intercepted by the OS

Recommended:
* Letter keys + Ctrl/Shift/Alt combinations
* F1-F12 function keys
* Numpad keys
hotkey.help.recommended_keys:
Recommended hotkey types:
+ Letter keys (A-Z)
+ Number keys (0-9)
+ Function keys (F1-F12)
+ Combinations (Ctrl/Shift/Alt + other keys)
+ Arrow keys

Not recommended:
- Media keys (volume, playback)
- Power key
- Fn function keys

welcome.title: Welcome to MouseMacros
welcome.page1.content:
Welcome to MouseMacros! This is a free, open-source mouse and keyboard macro recording tool.

By recording your actions, MouseMacros can help you:
* Automate repetitive tasks
* Improve work efficiency
* Reduce manual operation errors

This wizard will guide you through the basic features. Click Next to continue.
welcome.page2.title: Basic Operations
welcome.page2.content:
Using MouseMacros is simple:

(1) Record a Macro:
   * Press the record hotkey (%s)
   * Perform the mouse and keyboard actions you want to record
   * Press the stop recording hotkey (%s)

(2) Play a Macro:
   * Press the play hotkey (%s)
   * The program will automatically repeat your recorded actions
   * Press the abort hotkey (%s) once to pause; press it again to abort

(3) Save/Load:
   * Use the Save Macro and Load Macro buttons in the main interface
   * You can save multiple different macro files
welcome.page3.title: Hotkey Setup
welcome.page3.content:
You can customize all hotkeys:

* Click the Settings button in the main interface
* Select Custom Hotkey
* Click the input field, then press the key you want to set
* Click Confirm to save

Notes:
* Avoid using media keys (volume, playback, etc.), as they may not record properly
* Recommended: F1-F12 (one key per action)
* Ensure hotkeys don't conflict with other programs
welcome.page4.title: Get Started
welcome.page4.content:
You're ready to start using MouseMacros!

Tips:
* For your first recording, try simple actions as a test
* Enable Quick Mode in settings to ignore action delays
* Check logs or visit GitHub for support if you encounter issues

More Help:
* GitHub: github.com/Samera2022/MouseMacros
* Bilibili: UID 583460263

Thank you for choosing MouseMacros!
hotkey.warning.impossible_key:
ERROR: This key CANNOT be recorded!

Reason: This key (such as media keys, power keys) is processed at the keyboard firmware level, and is completely invisible to the operating system and applications.

Please choose a different key.
hotkey.warning.problematic_key:
WARNING: This key may not work on all systems.

Reason: This key (such as browser control keys, F13-F24) varies by device implementation and may not be capturable on some keyboards.

Recommendation: Prefer F1-F12 or letter key combinations.
